payload.message: Read tutor/progress.json. If schedule.paused is true, the student paused their lessons: do nothing and send nothing. If active_topics is empty, send a short friendly message (2-3 sentences) asking what topic the student wants to learn — suggest 2-3 interesting options. Do NOT read curriculum files or do extended research when there are no active topics. If active_topics has entries, take the first topic, read its curriculum at ~/.openclaw/skills/tutor/domains/<topic-slug>/curriculum.json and tutor/completions.json to find the next lesson not yet completed, and deliver a concise daily lesson with a small exercise, following ~/.openclaw/skills/tutor/SKILL.md. Keep total response under 200 words.
